title: 32 km inversion, 30 L-BFGS-B iterations under scpc_gamg on PR 155's head: a new paused solver every evaluation (the reference for the solver cache)
mesh: antarctica_320000_32000_buffered0 (Quartz's .msh, sha256 fd66fc42; 6,282 vertices, 9,055 cells), DG0 geometry, vertex raster sampling
initial_state: cold start: u = 0.1 u_obs, theta = phi = 0, the n,m 1 to 3 ramp under full_mumps, then ISMIP7_EVAL_CONTINUATION=0 (one annotated solve at full n an evaluation)
forcing: MEaSUREs v2 450 m (sha256 268be94e) and BedMachine v4.1 (sha256 6bd08dbb); ISMIP7_FLUIDITY_PRIOR=legacy; no dH/dt term
site: IU workstation (Mac, 16 cores, 128 GB), data under /Volumes/LaCie/Data/antarctica_general/ismip7_obs; ran about 09:10 to 09:16, beside another session's 4-rank 32 km run and 1 to 8-rank probe, so its seconds are contended (test-32km-inversion-reuse-lbfgs-before-rerun times the same comparison on a quiet machine); work counts, objectives and RSS do not depend on it
resources: 8 ranks; RSS a rank (mean over ranks) 1106 MiB after the first taped solve, 1293 MiB after the last; peak 1519 MiB
code: 4cf7f0e (PR 155 head, a git archive); icepack_tools e7b923e
cost: 313 s for 30 iterations (32 evaluations): 8.86 s an evaluation (median after the first), 8.31 s forward and 0.44 s adjoint; 99 NonlinearVariationalSolver builds (1.8 s) and 64 SCPC setups (10.7 s)
audit: objective 3.015616e4 to 3.746343e3, as test-32km-inversion-lbfgs-scpc-gamg; published residual 1.02e-3 after a 0-iteration final solve; no forward failed
notes: run under a probe wrapper (scratch, not tracked) that times solver construction, SCPC setup and each taped solve and logs each rank's RSS after every taped solve; it changes nothing the driver computes
